The first L4 large loop timed out after executing45actions; its cost cannot be attributed entirely to the normalization bug without a counterfactual.

At the candidateL5 tail, all8rotation-canonical target matches were true but the level had not completed. This disproves sufficiency of that chosen goal projection; it does not identify which remaining rule/target hypothesis is wrong.
